smooth.label: Trend + cycle
smooth.note: A smooth trend with independent noise. The textbook case.

step.label: Step change
step.note: A discontinuity. No smoother can represent it, so every method trades a spike in bias for its smoothness.

ar1.label: Correlated noise
ar1.note: AR(1) errors with phi=0.75. Wandering noise mimics trend, which is exactly what the independent-noise assumption cannot see.

stock.label: AAPL close
stock.note: Real prices, where the truth is unknown and the honest question is whether an apparent move clears its own error bar.
